description: A Twitch integration mod that makes subbs, bits and channel points do things like increase the player jump

releases.notes:
Fixes:
* The integration status is now sent to the player when they join the world/server

Changes:
* `/subathon info` now shows the channel info. (On beta 6 it was disabled)

New features:
* New event logs screen, it can be accessed by pressing the keybind (the default is `r`)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/40528665/160482544-1d71d069-822f-440b-9d3a-1b3ecd03f11a.png)

###### The event logs GUI uses some of ClothConfig code, give [shedaniel projects](https://github.com/shedaniel/shedaniel/blob/master/README.md) a check!

Changes:
* Major rework
* New method of getting subs, sub gifts and bits
* Complete rewrite of the integration code
* No more auth required!

New features: 
* Added a potion effect to see the effect level while in the inventory
* Added a custom rendering of the modifier value at the bottom right of the screen
* Added an "Integration offline" notification at bottom left of the screen
* New bugs!

Check README.md for instructions on how to use the mod
### The sub gifts may behave weirdly, this is being worked on and will be fixed on a future snapshot
### The icon is temporary and will be replaced with another one on the future
###### Also give the [Vault Hunters modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/vault-hunters-official-modpack/) a check!
